Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Ability to use a Spellcasting Focus
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 1
Order: Empower

Your Bastion is infused with the energy of one of Eberron's planes, chosen when you build the facility.

Empower: Manifest Charm. The hireling conducts magical rites for 7 days; you needn't be in the Bastion. At the end, you gain a Manifest Charm that lasts until you use it, whose effect depends on the linked plane.

  • Daanvi, the Perfect Order: expend the Charm (no action required) to end the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned condition on yourself.
  • Dolurrh, the Realm of the Dead: when you cast a Necromancy spell with a spell slot, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as cast with a spell slot one level higher than the one expended.
  • Fernia, the Sea of Fire: when you cast a spell that deals Fire damage with a spell slot, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as cast with a spell slot one level higher than the one expended.
  • Irian, the Eternal Dawn: when you cast a spell that restores Hit Points or deals Radiant damage with a spell slot, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as cast with a spell slot one level higher than the one expended.
  • Lamannia, the Twilight Forest: when you cast a spell that conjures or summons a Beast, an Elemental, or a Fey (Conjure Animals, Find Steed, Summon Fey, and the like) with a spell slot, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as cast with a spell slot one level higher than the one expended.
  • Mabar, the Endless Night: when you cast a spell that animates or summons an Undead (Animate Dead, Create Undead, Summon Undead) with a spell slot, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as cast with a spell slot one level higher than the one expended.
  • Risia, the Plain of Ice: when you cast a spell that deals Cold damage with a spell slot, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as cast with a spell slot one level higher than the one expended.
  • Shavarath, the Battleground: when you score a Critical Hit, expend the Charm (no action required) to deal an extra 10 damage of one of the attack's damage types.
  • Syrania, the Azure Sky: expend the Charm as a Bonus Action to gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 1 minute.
  • Thelanis, the Faerie Court: when you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell, expend the Charm (no action required) to give one target Disadvantage on its saving throw against it.
  • Xoriat, the Realm of Delirium: when you cast a spell with a spell slot, expend the Charm (no action required) to roll on the Wild Magic Surge table of the Player's Handbook.

A mobile Bastion loses its planar link while it moves, and you can't issue the Empower order in transit. When it arrives, the Empower order can establish a new link to the same plane or another one, which takes 7 days before the order works normally.

Source: Eberron: Forge of the Artificer.
